name: Deploying AI Applications
outcome: Deploy an AI-powered application in a standard environment.
description: Package and run an evaluated AI-powered application in a standard deployment environment. Configure dependencies, secrets and access, and perform smoke tests and basic operational checks.
external: Linux/CLI, Git, basic HTTP APIs, containers and dependency management. Ability to implement a bounded AI application.
prior: Git, basic HTTP APIs and containers
Ability to implement a bounded AI application or workflow (e.g. A02 or equivalent)
learn: Package an evaluated application with pinned dependencies
Run deployment smoke tests and inspect logs
moduleDescriptions: Package a supplied AI application with its dependencies and API interface.
Separate runtime configuration and credentials from source code.
Build and start a local container with restricted access.
Run smoke tests, inspect logs and document reproducible startup.
prerequisiteRationale: A07 supplies evidence that an implemented application is ready for packaging and smoke tests.
